# Zerventa

> Zerventa is an online CFD broker. Trade Forex, Indices, Commodities, Shares, Crypto and Metals as CFDs with tight spreads, leverage up to 1:400, fast execution and a browser-based web terminal that works on any device. Sign-up opens a free demo account with $10,000 virtual funds; live accounts start from a $200 deposit.

## Accounts
- [Compare trading accounts](https://www.zerventa.com/trading-account): account tiers, leverage, spreads and features.
- [Classic account](https://www.zerventa.com/classic-account): the standard account — every instrument and the full web terminal.
- [Silver account](https://www.zerventa.com/silver-account): spread discount and priority support.
- [Gold account](https://www.zerventa.com/gold-account): larger spread discount, trading signals and a dedicated account manager.
- [Platinum account](https://www.zerventa.com/platinum-account): deeper discounts, VPS hosting and premium analysis.
- [VIP account](https://www.zerventa.com/vip-account): bespoke pricing and service.
